lines.text: Goodness me. When did I drop that?
Do you need... some therapy?
If you need to get some things off your chest, come see me.
I'm always cooking up something new for you!

I enjoy looking after people who push themselves.
Like Eunhwa... or you. Heehee.
Whenever you feel tired, I'll be there for you.
You seem troubled. Penny for your thoughts?

Um, the Commander is always crazy busy.
Is it because he's always working hard for us? Oops.
Some therapy? Now's not really a good time. How about... a private appointment tonight? Heehee.

Dig in, guys...
Hey, where'd everybody go?
Sometimes when I'm repairing weapons in the armory... it feels like I'm a piece in an exhibit myself.
Are you hurt? How about you let me give you some TLC? Heehee!
I won't let you down.
I'll make you feel better... Every part of you.
My healing abilities are becoming more powerful.
Heehee, thanks.
You picked this for me? Oh my gosh, I love it!
Is this... a date?
You're the only patient who gets my TLC, Commander. Heehee!
We're getting closer don't you think? I feel it too.
Everyone in the squad is precious to me, but you're the most special of all. Wait, why do I think that?
Let's give it everything we've got.
Waiting for your orders.
On my way!
Battle engaged.
Let's fight together.
Get serious, OK?
I ought to punish you, heehee!
Cover me!
I'll take my chance.
Reloading as soon as I can.
Now, Commander!
I'll give you my... full attention. Heehee!
All together now!
Nice.
Neat.
Done.
Ugh!
Gah!
Huh!
Sorry, I need to take a rest.
If we work together, this'll be a walk in the park.
Here's to a merry Christmas together, Commander.
What do you think of this outfit? Do you like it?
The thought of spending Christmas with you makes me so happy.
I'm planning on whipping up something for Christmas. Would you like to eat together?
Now that we've changed into something more comfortable, would you like to go on a date?
No matter how cold the winter wind blows, I'll never leave your side.
Commander... Commander? Busy even on Christmas... such a busy bee.
You work so hard! I'll have to warm this place up for you.

When do you plan on coming to the armory?
Eunhwa, Vesti, and I have prepared a small party, so hurry up!
Where did everybody go? I cooked up something festive for the holidays.
The armory is practically a freezer during the winter, but it feels a little warmer whenever you show up.
Get a little closer if you're feeling cold. I'll give you a nice warm hug.
I'll try my best and work just as hard as you.
Oh my, acknowledged by the Commander. Thank you!
It feels like my body is a little warmer than before.
I was planning on giving you a gift first, but you beat me to it.
Thank you for making this Christmas a happy one, Commander.
Oh, just what I wanted! Thank you so much.
Whenever I think of you, my heart gets all warm and fuzzy.

It's a little cold in here...
Can I sit beside you?
I don't know why, but I feel like spending this Christmas with you and nobody else. Do you feel that way too?
Shall we get started?
Yes, Commander.
I wonder what's over there?
Off to battle we go!
Let's have a good time while we're out there, okay?
Let's score another one for the good guys.
Let's finish quickly so we can get back to the party.
My outfit is too short... it's a bit inconvenient.
It's even more fun reloading a pretty weapon.
Hang in there, Commander.
All set, Commander.
Come over here. I'll keep you warm.
Everyone, hang in there!
Ah haha.
We did it!
I'll keep doing my best!
Aghh!
Ack!
My hat!
Sorry Commander, but I'm going to go rest for a while...
Whoo, it's over! Now we can go party!
